prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium shot. A man seen from behind, his face not visible, leans his shoulder against the shut wooden door in the side of a giant long rectangular wooden crate of rough planks smeared pitch-black, with a flat plank roof and flat square ends, as tall at both ends as in the middle, both palms flat on the wet boards. Dusk, rain streaming down the black pitch. Helpless and cold. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
